title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.17340v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are expensive to update through full retraining. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces the cost of adaptation, but repeated adaptation creates a growing pool of task-specific LoRA adapters. This pool complicates adapter selection during inference. Existing routing and encoder-based methods often require retraining when new adapters are added, which limits their use in dynamic settings. This paper treats adapter routing as a representation alignment problem in the adapter-output space. The proposed training-free method selects adapters by matching adapter-conditioned query representations against task prototypes using cosine similarity. Experiments with LLaMA-2-7B and LLaMA-2-13B on a 48-task FLAN-v2 benchmark and on out-of-distribution tasks show that the method outperforms training-free baselines in the cross-task setting and approaches a trained retrieval encoder without learning a router. translated_title: LoRAWeaver：LoRA表示空间中的方向性适配器路由
translated_abstract: 通过完全重新训练来更新大型语言模型的成本十分高昂。参数高效微调降低了适配成本，但反复适配会产生一个不断增长的任务特定LoRA适配器池，这使得推理过程中的适配器选择变得复杂。现有的路由方法和基于编码器的方法在添加新适配器时通常需要重新训练，这限制了它们在动态场景中的应用。本文将适配器路由视为适配器输出空间中的表示对齐问题。所提出的免训练方法通过使用余弦相似度，将适配器条件化的查询表示与任务原型进行匹配来选择适配器。在LLaMA-2-7B和LLaMA-2-13B上进行的48个任务的FLAN-v2基准测试以及分布外任务实验表明，该方法在跨任务设置中优于免训练基线，并且在无需学习路由器的情况下接近经过训练的检索编码器的性能。消融实验证实了……
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的LoRA适配器路由方法，通过在适配器输出空间中用余弦相似度将适配器条件化的查询表示与任务原型匹配来选择适配器，在跨任务设置中优于免训练基线，且无需学习路由器即可接近训练过的检索编码器的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a training-free LoRA adapter routing method that selects adapters by matching adapter-conditioned query representations against task prototypes via cosine similarity in the adapter-output space, outperforming training-free baselines in cross-task settings and approaching the performance of a trained retrieval encoder without learning a router.
